component.name: Valentina
component.summary: Provides a cross-platform patternmaking program which allows designers to create and model patterns of clothing

description.p: Valentina is a cross-platform patternmaking program which allows designers to create and model patterns of clothing. This software allows pattern creation, using either standard sizing tables or an individual’s set of measurements. It blends new technologies with traditional methods to create a unique pattern making tool.
This is a edge release in the 1.1 series.

ul.li: Valentina app. Fixed the --dimensionC console export option silently applying the value to dimension B instead, and console export capturing the pattern's geometry from before a dimension change instead of after it.
Valentina app. Fixed a piece's seam allowance sometimes rendering as a garbled, self-intersecting outline at some size and height combinations.
Valentina app. Fixed a crash closing a Move/Rotate/Flip operation's options dialog after a change that adds or removes an operated object.
Valentina app. Fixed launching Tape or Puzzle from Valentina on macOS failing to find them when installed outside of /Applications directly.
Valentina app. Fixed Valentina silently doing nothing when it couldn't launch Tape or Puzzle; a warning is now shown explaining the launch failed.

Valentina app / Puzzle app. Fixed DXF point markers (notches, drill holes, turn points) showing as oversized circle-and-cross shapes that grow or shrink with the viewer's zoom level in some CAD applications.
Misc. Added Danish (da_DK) language.
Valentina app / Puzzle app. Fixed the piece name annotation text on ASTM DXF export being too small to read.
Valentina app / Puzzle app. Fixed the Style System Text on AAMA/ASTM DXF export ignoring the configured pattern label font size.
Tape app. Fixed the known measurements editor showing the wrong measurement diagram after renaming an image on the Images tab.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Saving a file and backing one up before a format conversion no longer freeze the window.
Valentina app. Fixed loading pre-1.1.1 patterns with a point cutting an arc into two segments failing due to a stale auto-generated name.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed a crash after a fatal data error where the program kept running on known-bad state instead of shutting down.
Valentina app. Fixed a crash on closing the pattern window while a curve tool's control-point preview was still on screen.
Valentina app. Fixed a crash in the Spline Path / Cubic Bezier Path tool dialogs when clicking "Add point" with an empty point selector.
Valentina app. The pattern loader now warns when a pattern file has two objects sharing the same name; pass --pedantic to make this a hard error.
Valentina app. Fixed Move/Rotate/Flip operations letting the auto-generated name of a resulting curve collide with an existing one.
Misc. Fixed nearly invisible placeholder text in disabled/read-only fields on custom dark theme and on Linux.
Tape app. Added an "Install…" button next to the known measurements database selector to install a .vkm file directly.
Valentina app. Fixed a seam allowance corner set to "by second edge symmetry" growing a stray spike instead of mirroring the matching corner.
Valentina app. Fixed a crash from a sidebar tab's hover-fade animation still running after the tab bar that owned it was destroyed.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Removed the single-bundle macOS package. Only the multi-app bundle is offered now.
Valentina app. Fixed the horizontal scroll wheel doing nothing on the pattern and layout views.
Valentina app / Puzzle app. Exporting details to SVG now wraps each piece in its own named Inkscape layer.
Valentina app / Tape app. Fixed placeholder and search-history menus splitting into multiple columns instead of scrolling on some Linux styles.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed exporting DXF files to a path containing non-Latin characters failing on Windows.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed a rare crash on shutdown when a second instance connected to an already-running one during a background country lookup.
Valentina app. Fixed a point cut by length along a multi-segment curve sometimes landing far from the requested distance.
Valentina app. Fixed the pattern not recalculating after changing the default curve approximation scale in Preferences.
Valentina app. Fixed a crash caused by a full reparse reissuing an id already used by an orphaned node.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Stopped Qt painting warnings from popping an error dialog.
Tape app. Fixed a crash while reading a measurement file whose format was not recognized.
Valentina app. Fixed a crash when opening Preferences after a monitor was disconnected or reconfigured.
Tape app. Fixed a crash while the known measurements database was being rebuilt in the background.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed a crash when closing the application while usage statistics were still being sent.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Stopped Qt network warnings from the background update check and usage statistics popping an error dialog.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed the interface freezing for minutes at a time when the settings file had grown corrupt.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed the crash reporter reading its settings from the wrong file.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed the interface freezing while usage statistics and country lookup made network requests on the main thread.
Valentina app. Fixed fold-line label font not updating live when changed in preferences.
Valentina app / Puzzle app. Fixed fold-line ("Cut on Fold") labels rendering upside down, mirrored, or offset on flipped pieces.
Valentina app / Puzzle app. Fixed a hang when generating a layout on a single-CPU machine.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed a crash when redrawing the mode sidebar icons on low memory or degenerate tab size.
Valentina app. Fixed a crash when deleting a tool while a point/curve creation dialog was still open.
Valentina app. Fixed a crash when closing or fully undoing a pattern.
Valentina app / Tape app / Puzzle app. Fixed a crash from a warning or critical message logged in the middle of another operation.
Valentina app. Fixed crash on startup in locales whose math function names translate to non-identifier characters.
Valentina app. Fixed sporadic crash when opening or closing a pattern file due to unsafe concurrent document access.
Misc. Fixed files occasionally being saved empty/corrupt by validating documents against their schema before committing.
Valentina app. Fixed crashes and stale dependency edges from the background formula dependency checker.
Valentina app. Fixed use-after-free crashes triggered by a full reparse after undo/redo.
Valentina app. Fixed crash when toggling a piece's in-layout state for a tool of the wrong type in the pieces list.
Valentina app. Fixed release-build crash when undoing or redoing deletion of a piece.
Valentina app. Fixed hang when uniting details with malformed union data.
Valentina app / Puzzle app. Fixed crash when a piece's fold line produced degenerate arrow shapes.
Puzzle app. Fixed crashes in the piece carousel when starting a drag on an empty item and when opening the context menu on a non-piece item.
Misc. Fixed potential crash when a text encoding could not be resolved to a codec name.
